newsitem.title: UK: Europe beet conditions stable, improving - Licht.
newsitem.headline: Europe beet conditions stable, improving - Licht.

text.p: Growing conditions for sugar beet have stabilised in Europe and crop prospects should further improve during the rest of this month, statistician F.O. Licht said on Wednesday.
In its daily report, Licht said European weather conditions had been fair for beet sowings during the week ended May 13 while more rainfall was expected for the rest of the month.
But drier conditions were reported in eastern Europe, which could benefit beet development.
"In the short term, this should help early establishment because moisture is currently mostly adequate to surplus in a few areas," Licht said.
The report noted that in Spain sugar beet areas had been mostly dry during the past three weeks although conditions were generally stable.
Additional rainfall was forecast for May, which should prevent a moisture shortage, it said. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
